prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE exceptionally clear original fantasy hunting equipment design sheet on an off-white studio background, landscape 3:2, high-detail hand-painted production concept rendering matching earthy gray-green leather, dull bronze fixtures, physically believable creature-derived materials. This is a NEW equipment sheet, NOT a monster portrait. Exactly ONE fully clothed ADULT neutral mannequin/hunter on the left third, full body visible from low fitted helmet to boots, calm front three-quarter stance, empty hands, practical unisex armor with five distinct regions (helmet, torso, forearms, waist, legs), covered torso, no exposed thighs, no exaggerated sexual anatomy. Open face, short low silhouette, free elbows/wrists/knees, hands and fingers visible. On the other two thirds show exactly SEVEN separate weapon groups in a clean organized 4+3 grid, each completely in frame, clear separation and enough empty space. Mandatory weapon groups: 01 large single-edged heavy sword; 02 short single-edged sword PLUS a separate small shield; 03 a long-handled hammer with CLOSED HARD striking faces, not a drum; 04 TWO matching short blades as one pair; 05 ONE long slender gently curved sword; 06 ONE long straight spear PLUS a separate long shield; 07 ONE slim working bow with a single taut string and a SMALL aiming ring plus one arrow. Do NOT omit any weapon family. Exact tiny text below groups only: 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07. No titles, Japanese letters, paragraphs, dimensions or ornamental UI. No monster body on the sheet. Soft material shadows only, no scenery, no flames or magical VFX obscuring shapes. The mannequin must not hold any weapon. Not a collage of existing pictures; render a coherent new collection.
Series 003: ヌメラドン / 泥冠. This sheet shows its native rank 1 only. Creature identity: 頭の泥受け皿と短い脚、平たい腹 Functional organ: 頭頂の泥受け皿と、その縁に並ぶ水圧嚢。取り込んだ水と細泥を練り、皿の前端から小さな塊として飛ばす。 Palette: 泥褐色／灰白の皮／くすんだ青緑. Overall armor silhouette: 丸く低い輪郭。耐水皮の重ね。兜に浅い皿。前が重い偏り.
Armor regions: head: 浅い泥冠皿を頭に沿わせ、縁を後頭より額側で厚くする; chest: 耐水皮を横段に重ね、胸前の低い泥晶板で水を左右へ逃がす; arms: 前腕の表へ丸い冠片、内腕は防水皮のひだ; waist: 左右の低い泥皿板で袋を支え、前中央は歩幅の分だけ開く; legs: 膝下を皮の巻き重ねで覆い、脛の平たい泥晶を三分割.
Weapons in fixed order: 01: 泥晶を薄く積層した幅広い片刃、背に浅い排水溝を一本; 02: 泥冠片の短い剣と、浅皿を裏返した丸みのある盾; 03: 硬化泥晶の短い円柱頭、前後の打面を平らに削る; 04: 水滴形の刃を二本、刃元を耐水皮で短く巻く; 05: 刀の峰を浅い水路形にし、先端は細く閉じる; 06: 水圧嚢膜を刃元へ封入した直槍と、縦溝のある泥冠長盾; 07: 耐水皮で包む弓身に泥晶の短い補強片、照準環は薄い滴形.
Native-grade material treatment: 浅い皿兜と丸い耐水皮段。武器表面の排水溝は一本. All armor is adult-sized even if materials come from a juvenile species. Preserve the small rounded juvenile material vocabulary where applicable, not child-sized clothing. Equipment sheets are illustrative concept art, not orthographic engineering diagrams.
review: 低い皿兜、重ねた胸・腕・腰・脚と7武器群を確認。泥晶面と耐水皮、小盾・溝長盾、硬い槌、双剣2本、弦付き弓と滴形小環・矢が分かる。兜縁の粒は泥晶の小留めとして読む。全体が画面内。
